period: FY23 fact-sheet snapshot in EY's December 2023 report; body text also calls it present employment
source_locator: PDF p9 factsheet explicitly labels100,000 employees FY23; p13 defines direct and indirect roles and cites TeamLease November2022.
definition: EY's broad Indian online-gaming employment estimate, explicitly including direct and indirect roles across core and support functions. The report identifies real-money gaming as 82.8% of FY23 online-gaming market value, so this is not a core video-game-development workforce measure. EY cites TeamLease Digital's November 2022 gaming report for the employment claim; detailed population, sampling and direct/indirect multiplier method are not stated.
